svg.aria-label: What v1 deliberately leaves out: voice cloning, because it is the most misuse-prone capability here and would need a mandatory consent step and audio watermarking to ship responsibly; and what is simply not wired yet with reasons given - Groq's Gemini-Flash tier, whose free tier is non-commercial and whose request shape was unverified, and streaming output.
svg.text: what v1 leaves out, and why

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the most misuse-prone capability in this space is missing on purpose, not by accident

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: audio - useful, and the easiest thing here to abuse.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: transcript, which is a real limit on long audio

svg.text: A roadmap that only lists features is a wish list. The entries above say what is missing, what it would take to

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: add it responsibly, and - for the cloning case - why shipping it carelessly would be worse than not shipping it.
